Every ZIP code in the United States, as a dot map

Each 2-pixel square is one ZIP code, placed at its latitude and longitude and coloured by its first digit. Because the first digit follows USPS sorting regions, the colours sweep across the country in bands — 0 in the Northeast, 9 on the Pacific coast — and the map of America emerges from the dots alone, with no state outlines drawn.

What the first digit means

The first digit is a national sorting area. Counts below are the actual rows in zipcodes.csv for each digit.

How to read it

Density is population: the Northeast corridor, the Great Lakes and coastal California resolve into solid colour, while the Mountain West stays sparse — ZIP codes there cover huge, thinly settled areas, so each dot sits far from its neighbours.

Watch the insets: Alaska (9) sits below the Southwest and Hawaii (9) below the South, repositioned by the Albers USA projection. Puerto Rico (0) appears just east of Florida.

The spec, translated

This page renders the Vega-Lite API snippet below as a declarative Vega-Lite 6 spec:

  • markSquare({size: 2, opacity: 1}) → a square mark, 2 px
  • calculate('substring(datum.zip_code, 0, 1)') → a new field, digit
  • projection('albersUsa') → the composite US projection
  • longitude / latitude channels → geographic position; digit → colour
  • Height is always floor(width / 1.75), with autosize: fit-x and no view stroke

The code you pasted — running above

From the Vega-Lite API v6 notebook (API 6.0.0 · Vega-Lite 6.4.0 · Vega 6.2.0). One correction was needed: the notebook cell references a field named zipcode, but the real vega-datasets file headers it as zip_code — so this page uses zip_code, matching the CSV, plus a tooltip on the full code.

VEGA-LITE API — ZIP CODES CELLObservable notebook
vl.markSquare({size: 2, opacity: 1})
  .data('data/zipcodes.csv')
  .transform(vl.calculate('substring(datum.zip_code, 0, 1)').as('digit'))
  .project(
    vl.projection('albersUsa')
  )
  .encode(
    vl.longitude().fieldQ('longitude'),
    vl.latitude().fieldQ('latitude'),
    vl.color().fieldN('digit'),
    vl.tooltip([
      {field: 'zip_code', title: 'ZIP code'},
      {field: 'city', title: 'City'},
      {field: 'state', title: 'State'},
      {field: 'county', title: 'County'}
    ])
  )
  .width(width)
  .height(Math.floor(width / 1.75))
  .autosize({type: 'fit-x', contains: 'padding'})
  .config({view: {stroke: null}})
  .render()
Data: vega-datasets — zipcodes.csv (42,049 rows; fields: zip_code, latitude, longitude, city, state, county). A copy is bundled with this page so it renders as-is. Built with Vega-Lite 6.4.0 · Vega 6.2.0
